messages:
incident-bot: Alert fired: gateway-usw2 5xx rate > 4% (rolling 5m). Alert ref: GATEWAY-USW2-5XX-20260315.
oncall-sre: I'm paged and looking. pulling edge proxy + mlworker metrics now.
devon: I'll stand by for routing changes. any deploys recently?
oncall-sre: no deploys in last 6h. traffic shows many long-lived streaming sessions. initial hypothesis: connection/conntrack exhaustion causing upstream errors.
jules: dashboards: https://dash.redwood.example.com/d/usw2/gateway?from=now-45m. spike lines up ~13:58Z.
sarah-p: checked node stats: conntrack table nearing full on several proxies; many sockets in TIME_WAIT and CLOSE_WAIT.
pmurray: partner X launched a change around 13:50Z increasing concurrent streams. might be related.
oncall-sre: logs showing 502s from envoy to mlworker: ``[envoy] upstream=mlworker-frontend status=502 path=/v1/chat duration_ms=1567`` lots of 504s for long polls too.
ops-lead: follow runbook for conntrack overflow. can we quickly shed traffic from usw2 to a healthy region? prioritize non-pinned and non-enterprise traffic.
devon: create traffic steer to euc1 for 25% as a quick test. command: `rbctl traffic steer --from=usw2 --to=euc1 --pct=25 --exclude=pinned`
oncall-sre: steering 25% now. Watching error rate.
jules: also bump keepalive on envoy from 60s -> 240s to reduce TIME_WAIT churn. applying via cfg-5021.
sarah-p: in parallel, bump NAT pool size and enable ephemeral port reuse (ops ticket 8012).
oncall-sre: after 25% steer: 5xx in usw2 dropped from 5.8% -> 3.1% in ~4m. euc1 shows slight latency increase but under SLA. will escalate steer to 60%.
pmurray: estimated impacted customers: ~2 partners with heavy long-polling usage; total impacted calls ~1.1% global. opening PSR (partner support request).
ops-lead: good. start controlled rolling restart of mlworker-frontend pods (1 at a time) to clear kvcache + stuck fds. command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/mlworker-frontend -n prod --max-unavailable=1`
oncall-sre: restart started. first pod shows reduction in 95th latency.
devon: add temporary per-src conn caps on nodes to prevent single IP from consuming too many sockets: iptables rule applied to prod-proxies: limit 120 concurrent connections per src IP.
jules: monitoring connection counts + conntrack entries. rule pushed as emergency change cfg-5023.
sarah-p: kernel netstat after changes: conntrack usage down ~40%. TIME_WAIT reduced by keepalive change.
oncall-sre: with restarts + conn caps + steer, usw2 5xx stable at 0.4% and overall latency back to normal.
customer-success: notifying partners now with guidance: reduce per-client concurrency and enable TCP keepalive; sending mitigations and ETA for change.
ops-lead: set incident severity to P1 until full recovery confirmed. create incident ticket INF-2026-219 with action items.
pmurray: adding customer impact summary to the ticket: window ~13:58Z -> 14:26Z (~28m). Affected request share 1.1% of global, mostly partner X and internal dev traffic.
oncall-sre: documenting steps in INF-2026-219: (1) traffic steer to euc1, (2) envoy keepalive increase, (3) conntrack caps, (4) rolling restarts of mlworker-frontend, (5) nat pool scale. Assign eng-runtime + eng-sre.
jules: recommending runbook updates: add quick conntrack diagnostic commands and a pre-approved steer play. will author a PR.
sre-next-shift: taking handoff at 14:45Z. please post final timeline and config diffs in the ticket.
oncall-sre: done. timeline added and diffs attached.
incident-bot: INF-2026-219 created and linked: https://incidents.redwood.example.com/INF-2026-219.
customer-success: partners confirmed reduced errors after their throttling change. no escalations beyond standard support tickets.
oncall-sre: incident marked resolved in monitoring at 14:26Z. initiating rollback of steer back to normal in 15m if metrics stay stable.
ops-lead: followups: 1) implement permanent per-IP soft limits at edge, 2) autoscale NAT egress pool, 3) add alert for conntrack high-water with graceful page, 4) partner-facing best-practices doc for streaming.
jules: adding dashboard tweaks to reduce noisy alerts and a playbook link to INF-2026-219.
incident-bot: Incident INF-2026-219 status: RESOLVED by @oncall-sre at 2026-03-15T14:26:10Z. Please complete postmortem template at /incidents/INF-2026-219/postmortem.
oncall-sre: thanks everyone. leaving detailed notes in the ticket. handing to @sre-next-shift for followups.
sre-next-shift: acknowledged, will validate NAT autoscale changes and the runbook PR tomorrow.
ops-lead: :tada: great work, quick coordination. closing this thread.
